extracted_fields._rawText: CLEAN & CLEAR foaming face wash is specially designed for young skin to remove excess oil, while its special ingredients help prevent pimples. Our upgraded formula helps keep your skin hydrated. It is gentle enough to use every day for clean and clear skin that glows. INGREDIENTS: Water, Propylene Glycol, Glycerin, Lauric Acid, Sodium Laureth Sulfate, Potassium Hydroxide, Myristic Acid, PEG-80 Sorbitan Laurate, Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Trehalose, Fragrance, Polyquaternium-7, o-Cymen-5-ol, Disodium EDTA, Citric Acid, CI 19140, CI 17200. Directions: Apply small amount on wet palm and work into rich lather. Gently massage onto face, avoiding eye area. Rinse off thoroughly. Use twice daily for clean, clear and beautiful skin. Safety Tip: For External Use Only. In case of eye contact, rinse with water. Any discomfort, discontinue use and consult physician. Keep out of reach of children. *Wash your face twice a day to give desired results. *When compared with the concentration of the ingredients of earlier formula (2018) of Clean & Clear Foaming Face Wash. Product may appear hazy or white, if stored at lower temperature. Change in product appearance doesn't impact product performance. Manufactured by: JNTL Consumer Health (India) Pvt. Ltd., V.P.O. extracted_fields.ai_summary: The product, CLEAN & CLEAR Foaming Face Wash, demonstrates strong compliance with most legal metrology requirements. All mandatory information such as net quantity (100 ml), MRP (₹199 including all taxes), manufacturing date (05/26), expiry date (05/29), manufacturer's name and address, consumer care details, batch number (B036210), and country of origin (India) are clearly and legibly displayed. The ingredients list is also fully provided. However, the product fails to meet 'clean label' criteria due to the presence of multiple synthetic chemicals and artificial additives, including Sodium Laureth Sulfate, synthetic fragrance, o-Cymen-5-ol, Disodium EDTA, and artificial colorants (CI 19140, CI 17200). These ingredients may pose risks of skin irritation or allergic reactions for sensitive consumers.

ingredient_dictionary: @{name=Water; description=The primary solvent and base for most cosmetic formulations, providing hydration and acting as a carrier for other ingredients. Generally safe.}

@{name=Propylene Glycol; description=A humectant that helps the skin retain moisture, and a solvent that aids in the dissolution of other ingredients. Generally safe, but can cause mild irritation in sensitive individuals.}

@{name=Glycerin; description=A powerful humectant that attracts water from the air to the skin, providing hydration and improving skin barrier function. Widely considered safe and beneficial for skin.}
@{name=Lauric Acid; description=A saturated fatty acid used as a cleansing agent and emulsifier, contributing to the lather and texture of the product. Can be mildly irritating to sensitive skin.}

@{name=Sodium Laureth Sulfate; description=A common anionic surfactant that creates foam and effectively cleanses by removing oil and dirt from the skin. Known to be a potential skin irritant, especially for sensitive skin, and can strip natural oils.}

@{name=Potassium Hydroxide; description=A strong alkaline compound used to adjust the pH of the product, ensuring it is within a safe and effective range for skin application. Can be corrosive in high concentrations.}
@{name=Myristic Acid; description=A saturated fatty acid used as an opacifying agent, surfactant, and emulsifier, helping to create a creamy texture and cleanse the skin. Can be mildly irritating.}

@{name=PEG-80 Sorbitan Laurate; description=A polyethylene glycol (PEG) derivative used as an emulsifier and surfactant, helping to mix oil and water-based ingredients and create foam. PEGs can sometimes be contaminated with 1,4-dioxane, a byproduct of ethoxylation, which is a probable human carcinogen.}
@{name=Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose; description=A plant-derived polymer used as a thickening agent and film former, providing texture and stability to the product. Generally considered safe.}

@{name=Cocamidopropyl Betaine; description=A mild amphoteric surfactant derived from coconut oil, used to boost foam, thicken the product, and reduce the potential irritation of other surfactants. Can cause allergic contact dermatitis in some individuals.}
@{name=Trehalose; description=A natural disaccharide sugar that acts as a humectant and skin protectant, helping to hydrate the skin and protect it from environmental stress. Generally safe.}

@{name=Fragrance; description=A complex mixture of natural and/or synthetic aromatic chemicals used to impart a pleasant scent to the product. It is a common allergen and irritant, and its exact composition is often proprietary.}
@{name=Polyquaternium-7; description=A synthetic polymer used as a conditioning agent, providing a smooth feel to the skin after rinsing. Generally considered safe.}

@{name=o-Cymen-5-ol; description=An antiseptic and preservative agent that helps prevent the growth of microorganisms in the product. It can be an irritant and has been flagged for potential endocrine disruption, though its risk in rinse-off products is generally considered low.}

@{name=Disodium EDTA; description=A chelating agent that binds to metal ions, improving product stability, preventing discoloration, and enhancing the efficacy of preservatives. It can enhance the penetration of other chemicals into the skin and has environmental concerns regarding its biodegradability.}
@{name=Citric Acid; description=A natural alpha-hydroxy acid (AHA) used primarily to adjust the pH of the product to an optimal level for skin and product stability. Generally safe.}

@{name=CI 19140; description=A synthetic yellow dye (also known as Yellow 5 or Tartrazine) used to color the product. It is a known allergen and can cause allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.}
@{name=CI 17200; description=A synthetic red dye (also known as Red 33) used to color the product. It can cause allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.}
